title: Hamburg despatch to the Hessian chancellor, 4/14 May 1672 (HStAM 4 f Dänemark Nr. 125 ff. 2-4; HCPortal 494)

documents.shelfmark: Hessisches Staatsarchiv Marburg, HStAM 4 f Dänemark Nr. 125, ff. 2-4 (HCPortal record 494)
documents.route: unidentified writer at Hamburg -> the Hessian chancellor (Herr Canzler), Kassel

plaintext.source: A second hand glossed nearly every code number and wrote partial readings of both letter-cipher passages (margin 'disgustirt und ertarin holstein'; letters over passage 2).

transcription.notes: Code 630 first read 650/680 (long-tailed 3); 'bb' in passage 1 is 66 (6 written like b). Only the cipher parts and their context are transcribed, not the whole clear text. ct.txt measures 40 tokens (38 letter-cipher signs + the codes 634 and 768 inside the passages); codes.txt lists all 26 code numbers, 24 of them outside ct.txt, so the letter has 64 cipher tokens in all.

system.summary: Hessian chancery nomenclator: five two-digit homophones per letter (20-166), doubled capitals as further homophones, signs for syllables, nulls 1-19, and three-digit code numbers 300-830 for names.
system.doubled_letters: enciphered as single letters (doubled capitals are homophones, not doubling marks)
system.sibling_key: HCPortal key 255 (HStAM 4 d Nr. 1234 ff. 13-16, Lincker 1666/1676): same letter table, different nomenclature
system.notes: Letter table: A-K take 20-69 in columns of ten (A 20 30 40 50 60, F 21 31 ...), L-U 70-119, W-Z 120-166; CC=a ... BB=z. The 1672 word list (codes 300-830) is not on HCPortal.

prior_solution.where: Glosses on the leaf (codes, margin reading of passage 1 with one word wrong, partial letters over passage 2); HCPortal 'Partially solved' without transcription. No published reading found.

conditions.human_role: Task posed from the catalogue entry by a coordinating agent; no target-specific intervention.

solution.what: Fetched HCPortal record 494 and its three full-resolution images.
Read the leaf: clear German despatch, 26 glossed code numbers, two letter-cipher passages on f. 4r (38 signs).
Web and HCPortal search for prior readings (letter, Blumenthal, Plön, Dano-Brunswick alliance, Antal & Mírka, Klausis Krypto Kolumne): only the glosses on the leaf.
Margin gloss 'disgustirt und ertarin holstein' tried against passage 1 with doubled capitals as nulls and as letters.
HCPortal key 255 (Marburg 4 d Nr. 1234, 1666): same type of table (homophones 20-166, doubled capitals); its nomenclature (Alliance 311) does not match the letter's codes.
Fetched all 319 HCPortal key records and screened the 106 Marburg 4 d / 4 f keys in contact sheets for a table of this type with codes 300-830.
Key 255's letter table (with its Scala, key 254) gives the glossed letters of passage 2 unchanged (63 g, 38 e, 22 b, FF d, 20 a, 75 s, 96 o, NN l, 50 a, 32 b, 110 l).
Syllable signs st and tt identified; passage 1 'disgustirt und ... in Holstein', passage 2 'Gott geb das all wol ablauff' (55 a slip for 53).
26 code numbers recorded with their glosses; 602 = Braunschweig from the struck gloss and 'Foedus Dano-Brunsvicense' in clear.
de-1640s LM search over the five open signs (e r t a d) allowing up to two copy slips.

outcome.method: read after matching with key from external sources
outcome.method_basis: The letter-cipher passages were deciphered with the letter table of HCPortal key 255 (Marburg 4 d Nr. 1234, Lincker 1666/1676), a key not tied to this letter and found here to fit; the code numbers come from the glosses on the leaf.
outcome.fraction_read_source: reading.txt over ct.txt (38 letter-cipher signs) and codes.txt (26 code numbers): 64 tokens, all given a value, 59 read as sense

gaps.item: passage 1, signs 28 83 117 20 66 (e r t a d) before 'in Holstein'
gaps.detail: The key reads them unambiguously but they make no word; the contemporary glosser failed at the same place ('ertarin'); an LM search with up to two copy slips found nothing; no second copy is online.

outcome.notes: 59 of 64 cipher tokens read as sense (92.2%). Letter table from HCPortal key 255; the nomenclature is a different, lost word list whose values come from the glosses. 625 (Statthalter Ahlefeldt?) and 653 (... von Brandenburg) glosses only partly legible. Writer not identified.
